# Chef's Choice

> > Chef's Choice offers a comprehensive range of professional-grade knife sharpeners featuring diamond hone technology for home and commercial use.

Chef's Choice, by EdgeCraft Corporation, is a leading manufacturer of electric, hybrid, and manual knife sharpeners. The site provides product collections, interactive tools, customer reviews, and educational resources for knife sharpening.

## Key Topics

- Diamond Hone Technology
- Electric Sharpeners
- Hybrid Sharpeners
- Manual Sharpeners
- Commercial Sharpeners
- Model 15XV
- Model 250
- Trizor XV
- EdgeSelect
- Knife Sharpening
- Kitchen Tools
- Product Reviews
- Ina Garten
- America's Test Kitchen
- EdgeCraft Corporation

## Product Collections

- [All Knife Sharpeners](https://chefschoice.com/collections/knife-sharpener): Main Chef's Choice knife sharpener product collection and models
- [Electric Knife Sharpeners](https://chefschoice.com/collections/electric-knife-sharpeners): Collection of Chef's Choice electric knife sharpeners with diamond hone
- [Hybrid Knife Sharpeners](https://chefschoice.com/collections/hybrid-knife-sharpeners): Chef's Choice hybrid knife sharpeners including Models 250 and 270
- [Manual Knife Sharpeners](https://chefschoice.com/collections/manual-knife-sharpeners): Chef's Choice manual knife sharpeners with diamond hone technology
- [Commercial Knife Sharpeners](https://chefschoice.com/collections/commercial-knife-sharpeners): Chef's Choice commercial knife sharpeners for professional use
